<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,824)>What’s going on? Are there any other Pokémon here
apart from you? How about humans?<$motion(1,652)>

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Uhhh... I don’t have a clue. All I know is I went to sleep,
and by the time I woke up, <$voicel(4,6)>everyone had moved away.

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)>Hmmm, interesting...
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>I wonder, would a whole town full of humans and Pokémon
really pull up roots and move all at once?
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)>As for you though, aren’t you lonely here?<$motion(1,652)>
<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,38)>Over here!
<$voicel(4,2)><$comeff(4,4)><$motionoff(4,804)><$facial(4,13)>Glub blub guh... Bluh!
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,13)>A-are you all right?!
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,13)>WHEW! That was a bad call. I nearly drowned!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>I opened my eyes and BAM—water everywhere. Talk about
a rude wake-up!

<$facial(4,9)><$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,666)>I’m not big on sleeping with the fishes. Think you could
clean the place up for me?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>! You got a sec?
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)>My home’s way brighter <$voicel(4,4)>thanks to you, and I’m really
happy about that...
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>But it’s also shed some light on a brand new problem...

<$voicel(4,8)>Look at this!
<$voicel(4,3)>See all that nasty mud? My shack’s surrounded by it! Yuck!

<$voicel(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)>There’s no way I can clean up this mess with my claws, and
I dunno what else to do.

<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>I know someone who’s real good at getting rid of stubborn
messes like this...
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,807)>Any chance you can get rid of the mud around my home?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>There’s a Pokémon who specializes in cleaning up stubborn
messes like that.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>I’m pretty sure they used to live near the water. I wonder
where they went.

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Huh? You wanna clear off some stubborn mud? That’s
the kinda thing I’m good at!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>I’d love to help! Lead the way to the mud!

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,38)>Woo-hoo! My home’s so nice and clean now!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,50)>You’re the best, <$cdef(27)>!
<$lookat(4,1,5)><waitactor(4)><$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>You helped out too, right, <$cdef(27)>Piplup</color>? Thanks a bunch!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(5,8)>You’re welcome! I like cleaning, so...it was fun!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,806)>Eh, I wouldn’t say I’m NOT lonely...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>But I’m the kinda <$cdef(27)>Meowth who likes doing their own thing!
No home, no boring rules—all play for this stray!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,14)>That said, I’ve always thought human houses are cool,
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)>so now that no one’s around, I moved into a little
shack nearby!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,802)>About that... It WAS a pretty sweet spot to live, but...
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)>Lemme show ya. Follow me!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,7)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,802)>Here’s the thing... The shack’s got a little problem.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)>Lemme show ya. Follow me!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,661)><$facial(4,9)>Anyway, you can see the problem. At some point, my little
shack got flooded!
<$facial(4,9)><$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,666)>Can you do somethin’ to clean up this watery mess?

<$lookat(1,0,4)><$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>You certainly seem to be in trouble, what with your home
flooded like that.

<$lookat(1,0,0)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)>If we can stop the flow of water, like we did with the
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center, <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,6)>I’m sure it would help immensely!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Anyway, you can see the problem. At some point, my little
shack got flooded with...
...<$voicel(4,2)><$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,665)><$facial(4,13)>Wait—it’s NOT flooded?!
<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)>Where’d all the water go?!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Hmmm... You’re saying this whole place was flooded
before?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,3)><$cdef(27)>’s been blocking the flow of
water
here
and
there,
<$voicel(1,10)><$emotion(1,40)><$facial(1,4)>so
that
must
have
helped
it
drain away!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,13)>Huh?! You...you cleaned it up already?
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>No way! Thanks a bunch. You really helped me out!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Looks like you met <$cdef(27)>Piplup</color>—nice!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>I bet you’ll have no problem getting rid of mud with them
helpin’ out!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Hmmm... I’ve certainly seen the waterways overflowing in
other spots as well.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)>And there’s not much tall grass at all here, which is a
shame—it makes such good homes for Pokémon.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)>Well, <$cdef(27)>, I think the best course of
action
is
to
first
get
rid
of
all
this water.
<$voicel(1,5)>And then start making homes for Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>If you do, you’re sure to make more new friends in this
area as well!<$motion(1,652)> <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)>I have every confidence in you!

Bring <$cdef(27)>Piplup along with you and stand in front of the
muddy mess.

<$cdef(27)>Piplup will spray the mud with bubbles.
Once the mud is covered in bubbles, you can wash it all
off with <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(3)>!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,29)>What mud do you need cleaned up? Just take me there!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>There! I’ve got the mud all bubbled up. Now just spray it
with water and it should wash right away!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,38)>Yaaay! It’s all clean now!

<$voicel(4,3)><$emotion(4,29)>Why don’t we clean up all the mud now? It’ll go real
quick if we work together!

<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Looks like this area’s got a ton of gross mud all over
the place.

<$comcan(4)><$voicel(5,5)><$comeff(5,3)><$motion(5,806)>Let me know if you ever need to get rid of mud again!
<$voicel(5,8)><$emotion(5,50)>I’ll help you wash it all away!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,27)><$facial(4,5)>Yeah, I bet you two could make quick work of it!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Oooh, and maybe you’ll find some cool stuff hidin’ under
all those piles of muddy goop!
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,803)>Hey, you! Got a sec?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,29)>Oho, you’re <$cdef(27)>Meowth</color>, aren’t you?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Whoa, the water’s all gone! My spot looks...spotless! Did
YOU do this? <$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,14)>Thanks a bunch!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>I bet other places around town got flooded too, huh?
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Wonder when it got like this...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,48)>The whole area would be way nicer to live in if all that
water got cleaned up!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>, can I ask you somethin’?
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Does this town seem dark to you? Like, weirdly dark all the
time, day and night?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Right?! Don’t get me wrong, I like the dark, but...
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)><$facial(4,9)>I don’t like it being this dark ALL the time. It kinda brings
me down, y’know?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Now I think about it, human houses looked bright even
at night, <$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)>but my little shack’s still pretty dark.
<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,6)>How do you think I could brighten it up?

<$voicel(4,10)><$emotion(4,27)>Whoa, great idea!
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>Like a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)> or something. Those things are
bright AND cool looking!
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Say, <$cdef(27)>... Can ya help me out?
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,29)>Could you make some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)> and put ’em
at my shack?

<$voicel(4,3)><$comeff(4,7)><$motion(4,802)><$facial(4,9)>I dunno if that’ll work... This area doesn’t get much light,
whether it’s morning, noon, or night.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>Humans kept their houses bright even at night... How’d
they do that? Hmmm... <$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,40)><$facial(4,4)>OH! I know!
<$voicel(4,5)><$emotion(4,49)>They used to put bright stuff in their houses to light ’em
up, like <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)>! <$voicel(4,8)>That’s gotta be it!
<$facial(4,1)><$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)>Say, <$cdef(27)>... Can ya help me out?
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,29)>Could you make some <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)> and put ’em
at my shack?

<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)> can be made using
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(819)>!
You can often find <$cdef(27)><$ifull(819)> growing
in caves.

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>It’d be awesome if you could spruce up my shack with <$cdef(27)>2
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)>!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>I bet that’ll make it nice and bright like a human house!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,49)>It’d be awesome if you could spruce up my shack with <$cdef(27)>2
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)>!
<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>I bet that’ll make it nice and bright like a human house!

<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)> can be made using<$cdef(27)>
<$ifull(819)>!
You can often find <$cdef(27)><$ifull(819)> growing
in caves.

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,38)>Nice! Those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1367)> brightened my shack
right up!

<$voicel(4,9)><$facial(4,5)><$comeff(4,21)><$motion(4,803)>Thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>! Wow, you can
do anything!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Oho! That really does look quite nice!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,806)>There’s something so calming about a bit of light!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,824)>Pokémon all have different individual quirks, you know.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,14)>So I’m sure there are some that prefer the dark.
<$voicel(1,7)>But this place was SO dark even <$cdef(27)>Meowth found it
too gloomy.<$motion(1,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)>If you keep adding more lights to the area, <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>it’s sure to
please other Pokémon too.
<$voicel(1,4)><$facial(1,14)><$comeff(1,14)>And I suspect humans are the same in that regard.
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,5)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,668)>After all, when the humans were still around, the towns
were brighter than this, even at night.

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)>Yes, I believe so. After all, when the humans were here,
towns were <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,668)>much, much brighter than this!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)>And since this area was so dark even <$cdef(27)>Meowth found it
too gloomy...<$motion(1,652)>
<$voicel(1,7)>If you keep adding more lights like this, <$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,664)>I’m sure you’ll
make other Pokémon happy as well!

<$voicel(4,4)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)>But I’ve got no clue where they went.
<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,3)>They used to live somewhere like this, though.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>The tall grass around here is different from the last town’s.

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)>Now that I look at it, the soil’s a different color as well. Do
you suppose that affects what kind of grass grows from it?
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,38)>Despite all my long years, there’s still so much I don’t
know. It’s a wide world out there indeed!

Just as <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(44)> guessed, the type of soil
determines what kind of grass grows from it.
Be sure to pay attention to the color of the tall grass when
you’re making Pokémon habitats!

<$voicel(4,5)><$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)>I bet other places around town got flooded too, huh?
<$voicel(4,7)><$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,666)>Wonder when it got like this...
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,48)>The whole area would be way nicer to live in if all that
water got cleaned up!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Hmmm... I’ve certainly seen the waterways overflowing in
other spots as well.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,9)>And there’s not much tall grass at all here, which is a
shame—it makes such good homes for Pokémon.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)>Well, <$cdef(27)>, I think the best course of
action
is
to
first
get
rid
of
all
this water.
<$voicel(1,5)>And then start making homes for Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>If you do, you’re sure to make more new friends in this
area as well!<$motion(1,652)> <$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,664)>I have every confidence in you!
